Bill.BriefDescription: Delaying the implementation of Initiative Measure No. 1029.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to delaying the implementation of InitiativeMeasure No. 1029; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that: (1) Theenactment of Initiative Measure No. 1029 by the people in November 2008established important quality standards for qualifications, training,and certification of longterm care workers; (2) these standards, whichare intended to improve the quality of care provided to vulnerableelderly persons and persons with disabilities, must be implemented ina costeffective and efficient manner that will lead to a more stableand qualified longterm care workforce; and (3) these goals are bestachieved through phased and measured implementation over time, with dueregard to the best use of available resources.
